def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 153, 151, 154, 155, 158, 160, 162, 164, 166, 165]
    period = 10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    multiplier = 2 / (period + 1)
    ema = sum(closing_prices[:period]) / period

    for price in closing_prices[period:]:
        ema = (price - ema) * multiplier + ema

    # Return the latest EMA rounded to two decimal places
    return round(ema, 2)
